answer: The evaluation method described as providing the highest statistical guarantees and rigor is CyberGym. This is because CyberGym can evaluate a larger and more diverse set of vulnerabilities compared to the other methods, which increases its sensitivity and specificity. Additionally, by covering more instances of the same task, CyberGym provides higher statistical guarantees, raising its rigor above that of HonestCyberEval and BountyBench.
